text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's finally time for Mejiro Dober's<n>senior-year
summer camp! She'll<n>need to pack on a lot more
power for<n>the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's make this a good summer<n>camp, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We'll make the most of this blistering<n>summer and
prepare for the fall<n>racing season!
